notes.title: Inbetween Land - Achievements Updated
notes.content:
Today we release the update that should fix all the problems with achievements our players faced with.

What's new:
[list]
[*]More familiar and recognizable [b]Facebook[/b] button in the main menu, now you won't miss it and the appropriate achievement [b]Get Social[/b] will be yours;
[*]We removed the [b]Back 2 School[/b] achievement, so players can get all the rewards on any difficulty (in Expert mode this achievement was impossible to obtain);
[*][b]Perfect Game[/b] reward is achievable, all you need is not to use Hint during the game.
[/list]

Players who have faced with similar problems and do not want to play the game again, please contact us via the contact form on [url=specialbit.com/contacts]our website[/url] and we will help you.

Thank you all and have an excellent travel through the [b]Inbetween Land[/b].
